beats.text: Netflix once offered itself to Blockbuster.
beats.note: The popular version makes Blockbuster the fool. The detail that matters is what Netflix was in 2000.

beats.context: Dollars. The price Netflix asked Blockbuster for in 2000, according to the founders.

beats.name: Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph
beats.role: Met Blockbuster CEO John Antioco. Randolph recalls being laughed out of the room.

beats.text: Netflix was a DVD by mail service.
beats.note: Streaming was still years away. Antioco called the dot-com hysteria completely overblown.

beats.name: John Antioco
beats.role: Left Blockbuster in March 2007. He later bought Netflix shares, according to CNBC.

beats.line: Hindsight makes bad decisions look obvious.
